data.text: DEC-35 was recorded with --supersedes DEC-33 by mistake: DEC-35 changes how the hooks are installed, not whether the prompt hook exists. The journal is append-only, so DEC-36 restates DEC-33 with what KAD-56 measured. A decision add that supersedes another could say what it is about to hide - 'this hides DEC-33 from decision list' - before writing; it said so only after.
